stem: Which condition is most commonly associated with atopic dermatitis in 50–80% of children?
explanation: Allergic rhinitis is the condition most commonly associated with atopic dermatitis in 50–80% of children.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because allergic rhinitis is associated with atopic dermatitis in 50–80% of children.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because asthma is associated with atopic dermatitis, but the stated 50–80% range refers to allergic rhinitis here.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because food allergy is associated with atopic dermatitis but is not the condition described by the 50–80% range.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because coarctation is not an atopic comorbidity.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because melanoma is unrelated to atopic dermatitis and is not a recognised associated condition here.
